en: Mayon Volcano erupts liquid magma that cools into solid igneous rock, demonstrating a change in the states of matter.
The saltwater of the West Philippine Sea is a homogeneous mixture where sodium chloride dissolves completely in liquid water.
Jose Rizal used invisible ink that undergoes a chemical change when heated, revealing his secret messages written inside novels.
The Philippine eagle's feathers contain keratin, a solid protein material that is both lightweight and highly flexible for flight.
The ice sculptures at the Baguio Flower Festival undergo a physical change from solid to liquid when left outdoors.
Freshly squeezed calamansi juice is a liquid solution where the fruit's acidic compounds dissolve completely in added water.
The bubbling mud pots of the Tiwi Geothermal Park release water vapor, which is the gaseous state of heated water.
The historic walls of Intramuros are built from coral stone and adobe, which are solid, naturally occurring mineral materials.
When fallen narra tree leaves decompose in the soil, they undergo a chemical change to become nutrient-rich organic compost.
The traditional banig woven from buri palm leaves utilizes the natural flexibility and high tensile strength of plant materials.
Halo-halo is a heterogeneous mixture containing distinct, visible solid ingredients like sweet beans and jelly suspended in cold milk.
The liquid water from the hot springs of Pansol, Laguna, undergoes a physical change into vapor when it boils.
